title: OES-Resilience: Benchmarking telemetry intelligence under real-world stress
description:
Open, reproducible benchmark for multichannel telemetry anomaly detection. Version 0.1.0 generates synthetic 512-channel signals under four regimes (stable, noisy, localized burst, global shock), scores sixteen 32-channel blocks with the transparent OES32 reference detector (0.45·max|x| + 0.35·RMS + 0.20·mean|x|, threshold 0.50), and reports deterministic false-positive, detection, exact-match and localization metrics with threshold sweeps.

Synthetic data only. Not quantum, not GPS or navigation, not a physical sensor, and no performance claims about real systems.
